```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 2.6)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

data_dir <- "G:/My Drive/_SharedFolder_CUCI-Est-de-Montréal/data"
dossier_clean <- file.path(data_dir, "usagers/clean")
combine <- read.csv(file.path(dossier_clean, "usagers_combined.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))
dico    <- read.csv(file.path(dossier_clean, "dictionnaire_variables.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))

texte_question <- function(code) dico$texte_question[dico$code == code][1]

couleur <- "#4F6396"

theme_rapport <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e1e0d9", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text  = element_text(color = "#52514e"),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

# Même légende de recodage que rapports/comparaison_ligne_personne_usagers.Rmd
legende <- list(
  q1  = c("1" = "Oui", "2" = "Non", "9" = "Ne sais pas"),
  q2  = c("1" = "Oui", "2" = "Non", "9" = "Ne sais pas"),
  q3  = c("1" = "Oui", "2" = "Non", "9" = "Ne sais pas"),
  q4  = c("1" = "Oui", "2" = "Non", "9" = "Ne sais pas"),
  q5  = c("1" = "Oui", "2" = "Non", "9" = "Ne sais pas"),
  q7  = c("1" = "Oui", "2" = "Non", "9" = "Ne sais pas"),
  q8  = c("1" = "Oui", "2" = "Non", "9" = "Ne sais pas"),
  q10 = c("1" = "34 ans et -", "2" = "35 à 44 ans", "3" = "45 et 64 ans", "4" = "65 ans et +"),
  q9  = c("est_montreal" = "Est de Montréal", "grande_region" = "Grande région de Montréal",
          "ailleurs_ile" = "Ailleurs sur l'île de Montréal", "exterieur_grande_region" = "Extérieur de la grande région")
)

graphique_radiogroup <- function(code) {
  lab <- legende[[code]]
  d <- combine %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[code]])) %>% select(valeur = all_of(code))
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(valeur = factor(as.character(valeur), levels = names(lab), labels = unname(lab))) %>%
    count(valeur, name = "n") %>%
    complete(valeur, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n), valeur = factor(valeur, levels = rev(unname(lab))))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = valeur, y = pct)) +
    geom_col(fill = couleur, width = 0.55) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(pct == 0, "", paste0(round(pct), " %"))),
              hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = "#0b0b0b") +
    coord_flip(clip = "off") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
    theme_rapport()
}

graphique_checkbox <- function(code) {
  d <- combine %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[code]])) %>% select(valeur = all_of(code))
  choix_distincts <- d$valeur %>% str_split("\\s*\\|\\s*") %>% unlist() %>% unique() %>% sort()
  n_total <- nrow(d)
  d2 <- map_dfr(choix_distincts, function(ch) {
    tibble(choix = ifelse(ch == "other", "Autre", ch),
           pct = 100 * sum(str_detect(d$valeur, fixed(ch))) / n_total)
  })
  ordre <- d2 %>% arrange(pct) %>% pull(choix)
  d2 <- d2 %>% mutate(choix = factor(choix, levels = ordre))

  ggplot(d2, aes(x = choix, y = pct)) +
    geom_col(fill = couleur, width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct), " %")), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.8, color = "#0b0b0b") +
    coord_flip(clip = "off") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))) +
    theme_rapport()
}

codes_radiogroup <- c("q1", "q2", "q3", "q4", "q5", "q7", "q8", "q9", "q10")
codes_checkbox   <- c("q7_1")

# Ordre naturel du questionnaire (numéro de question), toutes types confondus.
ordre_questions <- c("q1", "q2", "q3", "q4", "q5", "q7", "q7_1", "q8", "q9", "q10")

n_repondants <- function(code) sum(!is.na(combine[[code]]))
```

```{r results='asis'}
for (code in ordre_questions) {
  cat("**", toupper(code), " ", texte_question(code), "**\n\n", sep = "")
  if (code %in% codes_radiogroup) print(graphique_radiogroup(code)) else print(graphique_checkbox(code))
  cat("\nn = ", n_repondants(code), " répondants\n\n\\bigskip\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
